title: Import from Sun-Panel
intro: Upload icon settings exported from Sun-Panel and convert them into panel links. The result goes into the panel editor first; save it after review.
stepV1: Open-source edition (e.g. 1.3): System apps → Export/Import → Export config, which gives a .sun-panel.json file
stepV2: 2.x: System apps → Settings → Export/Import → Export, which gives a .zip file; tick "Include local icon files" to bring uploaded icons along
drop: Click to choose or drop the exported file
baseUrlHelp: Uploaded icons that are not in the exported file load from this address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3002. Leave empty to show the first letter of the name instead.
iconifyNote: {n} online icons have no built-in match and will load from api.iconify.design (as Sun-Panel does).
missingNote: {n} uploaded icons are not in the exported file. Go back and enter the Sun-Panel address to load them from there, or tick "Include local icon files" when exporting from 2.x.
skipDuplicates: Skip {n} addresses already in this panel
noLinks: The exported file has no links to import
created: Imported {n} links. Review them and click Save
overflow: Added {n} links. A panel holds at most {max}; {rest} more were left out
note_badUrl: invalid address or unsupported scheme, skipped
note_tooManyAlts: at most {n} custom addresses, the rest were removed
note_credentials: user name and password removed from the address
note_iconMissing: uploaded icon not in the exported file, using the first letter
note_iconTooLarge: icon image too large, using the first letter
note_iconBad: unsupported icon format, using the first letter
note_iconsTotal: inline images exceed the panel limit, using the first letter
note_truncated: name or description too long, truncated
note_tooManyLinks: over the panel link limit, {n} more not imported
note_emptyGroup: no importable links in this group
note_noName: no title, using the host name
note_iframe: opened in a popup in Sun-Panel, now opens in a new tab
